scripts.build:all: npm run build:web && npm run build
scripts.package:mac:portable: npm run build:all && electron-builder --config packaging/electron-builder.yml --mac zip
scripts.package:mac:dmg: npm run build:all && electron-builder --config packaging/electron-builder.yml --mac dmg
scripts.package:mac:x64: npm run build:all && electron-builder --config packaging/electron-builder.yml --mac zip --x64
scripts.package:mac:arm64: npm run build:all && electron-builder --config packaging/electron-builder.yml --mac zip --arm64
scripts.package:mac:universal: npm run build:all && electron-builder --config packaging/electron-builder.yml --mac zip --universal
scripts.test:runtime: npm run build && node scripts/verify-runtime.mjs && node scripts/verify-native-jobs.mjs
